GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) receptor agonists are a class of anti-diabetic agents that act by inducing insulin secretion and inhibiting glucagon release in a glucose-dependent manner. They are particularly promising because of their long duration of action, reduced risk of hypoglycaemia and the added benefit of weight loss.
